ritz_corner_state_passage.corner_maps: Let H be separable and let P_M be increasing finite-rank parity-invariant projections converging strongly to I. For each finite X, C_(M,X)(A)=P_(M,X) A P_(M,X), viewed in B(P_(M,X)H_X) with unit P_(M,X), is unital completely positive. Spatial compatibility gives a global UCP map C_M on the bounded local inductive algebra. The family is projective under compression in M; the corner inclusions are not unital inductive homomorphisms.
ritz_corner_state_passage.parity_and_witness: If omega_M^- = omega_M^+ o Theta_M and one fixed local selfadjoint odd contraction B satisfies omega_M^+(C_M(B))>=m and omega_M^-(C_M(B))<=-m for one m>0, then the pullbacks omega_tilde_M^sigma=omega_M^sigma o C_M have joint weak-star cluster subnets omega^sigma, obey omega^-=omega^+ o Theta and ||omega^+-omega^-||>=2m.
ritz_corner_state_passage.energy_tightness: Assume that for every finite X there is one fixed K_X>=0 with compact resolvent and local pullback densities rho_(M,X)^sigma satisfying Tr(rho_(M,X)^sigma K_X)<=E_X uniformly in M and sigma. For E_R=1_[0,R](K_X), delta_(M,X,R)=Tr rho(1-E_R)<=E_X/R and ||rho-E_R rho E_R||_1<=2 sqrt(E_X/R). Finite-rank corner compactness plus this modulus yields local trace-norm precompactness, compatible density matrices and locally normal cluster states.
ritz_corner_state_passage.prior_credit: EXP-000781 certificate Section 6 already supplied the compact-resolvent energy-tail compactness principle for Q3LOCK local Gibbs reductions. R-167 v3.5 does not reclaim that result. Its new content is the parity-compatible corner UCP pullback, one fixed witness surviving the pullback, the explicit gentle trace-norm modulus, and the singular energy-escape fixture showing why the energy premise is necessary.
ritz_corner_state_passage.boundary: Weak-star compactness and a fixed witness alone preserve distinct parity-related states on the bounded algebra, but do not imply that their limits are locally normal. No KMS, ground-state, GNS-gap or dynamics statement follows.

compression_dynamics_firewall.multiplication_defect: For every projection P, C_P(AB)-C_P(A)C_P(B)=P A(I-P)B P. On l2(N_0), with P_M onto e_0,...,e_(M-1), A=S^* and B=S for the unilateral shift, the defect is the rank-one projection onto e_(M-1), hence has operator norm one for every M.
compression_dynamics_firewall.generator_defect: For delta(A)=i[H,A] and delta_P(A)=i[PHP,A] on the corner, C_P(delta A)-delta_P(C_P A)=i(PH(I-P)AP-PA(I-P)HP). This cross-boundary term need not vanish or converge in norm.
compression_dynamics_firewall.boundary: The UCP pullback transfers states and fixed bounded expectations. It does not automatically transfer products, derivations, dynamics, KMS boundary conditions or ground-state inequalities. This exact fixture does not preclude stronger convergence on a separately controlled core or under separately proved cross-boundary estimates.

positive_time_trace_class_passage.abstract_setup: Let h>=0 have compact resolvent, P=1_{0}(h) have finite rank r, Q=I-P, and suppose Z_0(t)=Tr exp(-t h) and Z_1(t)=Tr(h exp(-t h)) are finite for the fixed t>0. If V is selfadjoint and -B<=V<=B for B=alpha h+epsilon I, then V=B^(1/2) C B^(1/2) for a selfadjoint contraction C.
positive_time_trace_class_passage.trace_bound: T_t=exp(-t h/2) V exp(-t h/2) is trace class and ||T_t||_1<=alpha Z_1(t)+epsilon Z_0(t). For spectral Ritz projections Pi_M commuting with h and increasing strongly to I, ||Pi_M T_t Pi_M-T_t||_1 tends to zero.
positive_time_trace_class_passage.dressed_blocks: The exact dressed estimates are ||PVP||_op<=epsilon, ||PVP||_HS<=epsilon sqrt(r), ||P V Q exp(-t h/2)||_HS<=sqrt(epsilon Tr_Q[(alpha h+epsilon I)exp(-t h)]), and ||exp(-t h/2) QVQ exp(-t h/2)||_1<=Tr_Q[(alpha h+epsilon I)exp(-t h)]. They are not undressed DFFR (5.21) constants.
positive_time_trace_class_passage.q3_edge: For h_0=(k_x+k_y)/6+J(1-s_x s_y) with J>0, assume s=s^*, ||s||<=1 and [k,s]=0 on one site. The two-site bond penalty is positive and commutes with k_x+k_y. Define Z_k(u)=Tr exp(-u k). Dropping that commuting positive penalty gives Z_(0,e)(t)<=Z_k(t/6)^2. The scalar inequality x exp(-t x)<=2 exp(-t x/2)/(e t), followed by the same positive-penalty trace bound at t/2, gives Z_(1,e)(t)<=2 Z_k(t/12)^2/(e t). Hence a residual bounded by alpha_N h_0+beta_N I obeys ||T_(N,t)||_1<=2 alpha_N Z_k(t/12)^2/(e t)+beta_N Z_k(t/6)^2.
positive_time_trace_class_passage.uniformity_boundary: For each fixed N and t>0 with the displayed heat traces finite, spectral Ritz removal is genuine trace-norm convergence. Any N-uniform conclusion requires separately proved N-uniform heat-trace control. The theorem gives neither t=0 trace control nor a DFFR contour norm, transition-amplitude estimate, simplex summability or phase passage.

exact_obstructions.dimension_normalized_schatten: On C direct-sum C^m let Q be the high projection, h=N^2 Q and V=|f_1><f_2|+|f_2><f_1|. Then |V|<=N^-2 h and ||V||_op=1, while the dimension-normalized Schatten p quantity m^(-1/p)||V||_p=(2/m)^(1/p) tends to zero. The fixed transition matrix element remains one. Thus dimension-normalized Schatten smallness is not an automatic DFFR transition or contour smallness statement.
exact_obstructions.fixed_positive_time: On C direct-sum C^m put h_m=mQ_m and V_m=Q_m. For every fixed t>0, ||exp(-t h_m/2)V_m exp(-t h_m/2)||_1=m exp(-tm) tends to zero, but for every t_0>0 its supremum over 0<t<=t_0 is m. Positive-time trace decay therefore supplies no t=0 or short-time-uniform DFFR contour entry.
exact_obstructions.energy_escape: Let e_+,e_- and f_n^+,f_n^- be orthonormal, parity exchange plus and minus, and psi_n^sigma=sqrt(m_0)e_sigma+sqrt(1-m_0)f_n^sigma with 0<m_0<1. Their vector states have norm distance two and the fixed compact odd witness B_0=|e_+><e_+|-|e_-><e_-| has expectations plus/minus m_0. Against compact A the limits retain only m_0<e_sigma,Ae_sigma>, so the missing mass 1-m_0 is singular. For K f_n^sigma=n f_n^sigma the energy is (1-m_0)n and diverges. Fixed-witness separation without local energy tightness does not force locally normal limits.
exact_obstructions.ritz_corner_ucp_dynamics: For every cutoff rank M, the unilateral-shift fixture with A=S^*, B=S has C_M(AB)-C_M(A)C_M(B) equal to the rank-one projection onto the last retained basis vector, with norm one. With H=S+S^* and observable S, the generator defect i(P_M H Q_M S P_M-P_M S Q_M H P_M) also has rank and norm one. Therefore Ritz-corner UCP pullback does not automatically imply asymptotic multiplicativity or dynamics intertwining. Core-specific or cross-boundary convergence under additional hypotheses remains possible.
